import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Fraud distribution
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
fraud_counts = df['is_fraud'].value_counts()
colors = ['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c']
ax1.bar(['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], fraud_counts.values, color=colors, alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Fraud vs Legitimate Transactions', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction amount distribution by fraud status
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1:])
df_fraud = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount']
df_legit = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount']
ax2.hist([df_legit, df_fraud], bins=30, label=['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], 
         color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.6, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Fraud Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fraud rate by transaction type
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
fraud_by_type = df.groupby('transaction_type')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'] = (fraud_by_type['sum'] / fraud_by_type['count']) * 100
fraud_by_type = fraud_by_type.sort_values('fraud_rate', ascending=True)
bars = ax3.barh(fraud_by_type.index, fraud_by_type['fraud_rate'], color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Transaction amount by type and fraud status
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:])
df_plot = df.copy()
df_plot['fraud_status'] = df_plot['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Legitimate', 1: 'Fraud'})
sns.boxplot(data=df_plot, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='fraud_status', 
            palette={'Legitimate': '#2ecc71', 'Fraud': '#e74c3c'}, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amount by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Status', fontsize=9)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Fraud activity by hour of day
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
hourly_fraud = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'] = (hourly_fraud['sum'] / hourly_fraud['count']) * 100
ax5_twin = ax5.twinx()
ax5.bar(hourly_fraud.index, hourly_fraud['count'], alpha=0.4, color='#3498db', label='Total Transactions', edgecolor='black')
ax5_twin.plot(hourly_fraud.index, hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], color='#e74c3c', 
              marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=6, label='Fraud Rate (%)')
ax5.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Transactions', fontsize=10, color='#3498db')
ax5_twin.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=10, color='#e74c3c')
ax5.set_title('Transaction Volume and Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#3498db')
ax5_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#e74c3c')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax5.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

# 6. Summary statistics
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax6.axis('off')
total_trans = len(df)
total_fraud = df['is_fraud'].sum()
fraud_pct = (total_fraud / total_trans) * 100
avg_amount_legit = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount'].mean()
avg_amount_fraud = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount'].mean()

summary_text = f"""
SUMMARY STATISTICS

Total Transactions: {total_trans:,}
Fraudulent: {total_fraud:,} ({fraud_pct:.1f}%)
Legitimate: {total_trans - total_fraud:,}

Avg Amount (Legit): ${avg_amount_legit:.2f}
Avg Amount (Fraud): ${avg_amount_fraud:.2f}

Transaction Types: {df['transaction_type'].nunique()}
"""
ax6.text(0.1, 0.5, summary_text, fontsize=10, verticalalignment='center',
         family='monospace', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.3))

plt.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
